
```{r}
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
f <- tibble::tribble(
    ~st, ~prod,
     "MN", "apple",
     "WI", "apple",
     "MN", "banana",
     "WI", "grape"
    )
f
```


```{r}
p <- tibble::tribble(
    ~pr, ~co,
     "apple", 2,
     "banana", 1,
     "mango", 3
    )
p
```


```{r}
left_join(f, p, join_by(prod == pr))
```

```{r}
right_join(p, f, join_by(pr == prod))
```

```{r}
left_join(p, f, join_by(pr == prod))
```

```{r}
right_join(f, p, join_by(prod == pr))
```



```{r}
inner_join(f, p, join_by(prod == pr))
```

```{r}
inner_join(p, f, join_by(pr == prod))
```


```{r}

```

```{r}

```

```{r}

```
